COMMAND 3.1 — INSTALL THE EVIDENCE MINIMUM STANDARD
Evidence summary (what you know vs don’t)
A critical decision cannot be declared without evidence minimum met.
No heavy/critical decision is allowed with only one option presented.
Do not apply “critical rigor” to reversible decisions.
Decision speed is not being artificially slowed on light decisions
Prevent predictable cognitive errors from corrupting rapid decisions.
Confirmation bias: “Am I only seeing supporting evidence?”
Anchoring: “Am I trapped by the first number/idea?”
Availability bias: “Am I overweighting recent vivid examples?”
Ego commitment: “Am I defending my past stance?”
If any bias is flagged, the decision must include a contrarian input before closure.
